title: Retries and cancellation
objective: Pass AbortSignal into fetch, distinguish HTTP 4xx and 5xx, and bound automatic retry behavior.
predict: Canceling a stale query should not cache a late response; HTTP 422 must not be retried, while an intermittent 503 can be retried a bounded number of times.
expectedBehavior: Abort an in-flight request on unmount; ensure no stale result is committed. Mock 422 (zero retries), 503 (bounded retries), and a network failure.
commonFailure: The starter discards AbortSignal, ignores response.ok, and retries errors indiscriminately.
securityBoundary: Do not retry credential failures or validation errors; aggressive retries can amplify a production incident and expose service capacity limits.
